';
  sword.before(ornament);
})();
</script>

<style>

  50% { transform: translate(-47%, -2%) skewX(6deg) scale(1.08); opacity: var(--aura-opacity); }

<style>
.blade-sakura {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.blade-speaking-petals {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity .45s ease-out, visibility 0s linear .45s;
}
body:has(#bladeCenter[data-speaking="true"]) .blade-speaking-petals {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition: opacity .7s ease-in, visibility 0s;
}
.blade-petal {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--start-height);
  left: -20px;
  width: var(--size);
  height: calc(var(--size) * .74);
  opacity: 0;
  perspective: 64px;
  animation: blade-petal-fall var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite;
}
.blade-petal::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 33% 25%, #ffe1ef, #dd8bb4 58%, #8b315f);
  clip-path: polygon(0 50%, 14% 21%, 44% 0, 71% 6%, 95% 25%, 84% 45%, 100% 53%, 88% 77%, 62% 97%, 33% 90%, 11% 73%);
  animation: blade-petal-tumble var(--tumble) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
}
body:not(:has(#bladeCenter[data-speaking="true"])) .blade-speaking-petals .blade-petal,
body:not(:has(#bladeCenter[data-speaking="true"])) .blade-speaking-petals .blade-petal::before {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}
@keyframes blade-petal-fall {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
  8%, 91% { opacity: var(--opacity); }
  23% { transform: translate3d(22vw, calc(var(--drop) * .27), 0); }
  44% { transform: translate3d(47vw, calc(var(--drop) * .19), 0); }
  72% { transform: translate3d(80vw, calc(var(--drop) * .72), 0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(calc(100vw + 42px), var(--drop), 0); }
}
@keyframes blade-petal-tumble {
  from { transform: rotateX(-48deg) rotateZ(-27deg); }
  to { transform: rotateX(56deg) rotateZ(83deg); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blade-sakura { display: none; }
}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const layer = document.createElement('div');
  layer.className = 'blade-sakura';
  layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const speakingPetals = document.createElement('div');
  speakingPetals.className = 'blade-speaking-petals';
  const ambientCount = 20;
  const speakingCount = 36;
  for (let i = 0; i < ambientCount + speakingCount; i++) {
    const added = i >= ambientCount;
    const foreground = added && i % 4 === 0;
    const petal = document.createElement('span');
    petal.className = 'blade-petal';
    petal.style.setProperty('--start-height', (3 + (i * 17) % 61) + 'vh');
    petal.style.setProperty('--drop', 'min(' + (31 + (i * 11) % 22) + 'vw, 41vh)');
    petal.style.setProperty('--size', (foreground ? 15 + i % 7 : 6 + (i * 7) % 8) + 'px');
    petal.style.setProperty('--duration', (10 + (i * 3) % 7) + 's');
    petal.style.setProperty('--delay', (-(i * 1.71) % 13) + 's');
    petal.style.setProperty('--tumble', (1.7 + (i % 5) * .37) + 's');
    petal.style.setProperty('--opacity', String(.46 + (i % 5) * .09));
    (added ? speakingPetals : layer).append(petal);
  }
  layer.append(speakingPetals);
  document.getElementById('bladeTheme').append(layer);
})();
</script>

<style>

@keyframes blade-painted-tumble {
  from { transform: rotateY(-42deg) rotateZ(-30deg); }
  to { transform: rotateY(52deg) rotateZ(76deg); }
}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const reduceMotion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  const background = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundImage;
  const source = background.match(/url\("?(data:image\/[^")]+)"?\)/)?.[1];
  if (!source) return;

  // Centers and radii are measured against the original 2560 × 1440 image.
  const branches = [
    [480, 132, 570, 162, 8, 11],
    [279, 330, 350, 164, 7, 9],
    [644, 425, 290, 123, 13, 10],
    [931, 205, 280, 133, 12, 11],
    [234, 567, 123, 64, 4, 7],
    [1977, 597, 120, 54, 4, 7],
    [2483, 366, 152, 81, 5, 8],
    [2399, 678, 75, 48, 4, 7]
  ];
  const loosePetals = [
    [183, 321, 18, 15], [370, 507, 26, 24],
    [824, 341, 24, 21], [871, 380, 23, 19], [959, 398, 17, 14],
    [950, 490, 22, 19], [878, 501, 30, 24], [781, 515, 12, 16],
    [715, 602, 42, 33, true], [268, 664, 27, 21],
    [973, 662, 23, 17], [1020, 708, 23, 15],
    [91, 978, 37, 29], [91, 1042, 37, 29],
    [2520, 976, 48, 34], [2521, 1048, 47, 35]
  ];
  const bankVegetation = [
    [397, 618, 26, 14, 1.2, .6],
    [511, 744, 24, 13, 1.1, .6],
    [644, 769, 30, 12, 1.3, .6],
    [1927, 625, 34, 16, 1.2, .65],
    [2338, 700, 31, 14, 1.1, .6]
  ];
  const regions = [...branches, ...bankVegetation];
  const fragment = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform sampler2D uImage;
    uniform vec4 uRegions[${regions.length}];
    uniform vec2 uOffsets[${regions.length}];
    uniform vec2 uCover;
    uniform float uWaterTime;
    uniform float uRedMoon;
    uniform float uWind;
    uniform vec2 uTipRippleOrigin;
    uniform float uTipRippleAge;
    varying vec2 vView;

    float cascade(vec2 point, float x, float top, float bottom, float width, float lean) {
      float column = x + (point.y - top) * lean;
      return (1. - smoothstep(width * .52, width, abs(point.x - column)))
        * smoothstep(top, top + 20., point.y)
        * (1. - smoothstep(bottom - 49., bottom, point.y));
    }

    void main() {
      vec2 original = vec2(.5 + (vView.x - .5) * uCover.x, vView.y * uCover.y);
      vec2 position = original * vec2(2560., 1440.);
      vec2 offset = vec2(0.);
      for (int i = 0; i < ${regions.length}; i++) {
        vec4 region = uRegions[i];
        vec2 relative = (position - region.xy) / region.zw;
        float weight = 1. - smoothstep(.19, 1., length(relative));
        if (i >= ${branches.length}) weight *= 1. - smoothstep(-.1, .85, relative.y);
        offset += weight * uOffsets[i];
      }
      // Keep the falls inside the water channels traced in the reference.
      float falls = max(cascade(position, 2157., 491., 760., 32., -.074),
                        .65 * cascade(position, 2170., 598., 770., 28., .065));
      float stream = position.y * .049 - uWaterTime * 4.7 + position.x * .105;
      float run = sin(stream) + .37 * sin(stream * 1.93 + 1.2);
      offset.y += falls * (5.3 * run);
      offset.x += falls * sin(stream * .72 + 1.1) * 1.15;

      // Surface motion fades at the distant bank and around the foreground rocks.
      float waterX = smoothstep(710., 910., position.x)
        * (1. - smoothstep(2210., 2445., position.x));
      float surface = waterX * smoothstep(810., 851., position.y)
        * (1. - smoothstep(1168., 1210., position.y));
      vec2 center = vec2(1360., 975.);
      vec2 spread = (position - center) * vec2(.32, 1.15);
      float rings = length(spread) * .064 - uWaterTime * 2.3;
      float wideWave = sin(position.y * .075 + position.x * .012 - uWaterTime * 1.8);
      float nearReflection = 1. - smoothstep(105., 530., abs(position.x - center.x));
      float swell = 1. + .28 * uWind;
      offset.x += swell * surface * (3.4 * wideWave + 2.8 * nearReflection * sin(rings));
      offset.y += swell * surface * (1.85 * sin(rings + .5) + 1.2 * wideWave);

      // Light surface ripples continue into the two sheltered sides of the lake.
      float sideY = smoothstep(858., 901., position.y)
        * (1. - smoothstep(1155., 1205., position.y));
      float leftBank = 238. + 255. * (1. - smoothstep(855., 943., position.y));
      float rightRock = (position.y - 901.) / 63.;
      float rightBank = 2390. - 153. * exp(-rightRock * rightRock);
      float leftWater = smoothstep(leftBank, leftBank + 100., position.x)
        * (1. - smoothstep(705., 1180., position.x));
      float rightWater = smoothstep(1600., 2050., position.x)
        * (1. - smoothstep(rightBank - 110., rightBank, position.x));
      float sideWater = sideY * max(leftWater, rightWater);
      float sideWave = sin(position.y * .064 + position.x * .013 - uWaterTime * 1.46);
      float crossWave = sin(position.y * .097 - position.x * .008 - uWaterTime * 1.15);
      offset.x += swell * sideWater * (2.2 * sideWave + .75 * crossWave);
      offset.y += swell * sideWater * (.85 * crossWave + .5 * sideWave);

      float tipReflection = 0.;
      if (uRedMoon > .001 && uTipRippleAge >= 0. && position.y > 817. && position.y < 1222.) {
        vec2 projected = (position - uTipRippleOrigin) * vec2(1., 3.7);
        float distanceToTip = length(projected);
        if (distanceToTip < 1230.) {
          float banks = smoothstep(leftBank + 8., leftBank + 112., position.x)
            * (1. - smoothstep(rightBank - 105., rightBank - 4., position.x));
          float water = banks * smoothstep(817., 851., position.y)
            * (1. - smoothstep(1188., 1222., position.y)) * uRedMoon;
          float bend = 0.;
          for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            float delay = uTipRippleAge - float(i) * .75;
            if (delay >= 0.) {
              float age = mod(delay, 3.75);
              float radius = 18. + age * 320.;
              float progress = (distanceToTip - radius) / (11. + age * 3.8);
              float fade = smoothstep(0., .16, age) * (1. - smoothstep(2.48, 3.73, age));
              float crest = exp(-progress * progress) * fade;
              bend += sin(progress * 2.35) * crest;
              tipReflection += crest * (.18 + .037 * cos(progress * 2.));
            }
          }
          vec2 direction = projected / max(1., distanceToTip);
          offset += vec2(20., 8.5) * direction * bend * water;
          tipReflection *= water;
        }
      }

      vec4 picture = texture2D(uImage, original - offset / vec2(2560., 1440.));

      // Feather the cloud layers into the painted sky around the moon and tower.
      float cloudBand = max(
        (1. - smoothstep(.46, 1., length((position - vec2(1824., 380.)) / vec2(145., 59.)))),
        (1. - smoothstep(.42, 1., length((position - vec2(2370., 277.)) / vec2(157., 60.)))));
      cloudBand = max(cloudBand,
        1. - smoothstep(.44, 1., length((position - vec2(1030., 531.)) / vec2(112., 32.))));
      if (cloudBand > .001) {
        // Two staggered passes keep the drift heading right through each loop.
        float first = fract(uWaterTime / 44. + .5);
        float second = fract(first + .5);
        float blend = .5 - .5 * cos(first * 6.2831853);
        vec3 firstPass = texture2D(uImage, original - vec2((first - .5) * 68. / 2560., 0.)).rgb;
        vec3 secondPass = texture2D(uImage, original - vec2((second - .5) * 68. / 2560., 0.)).rgb;
        picture.rgb = mix(picture.rgb, mix(secondPass, firstPass, blend), cloudBand);
      }
      picture.rgb += vec3(1., .76, .87) * tipReflection;
      picture.rgb *= 1. + .11 * falls * run
        + swell * (.033 * surface * nearReflection * sin(rings - .6)
                   + .018 * sideWater * crossWave);
      // Measure the full moon limb in the original image, including the tall lower arc.
      if (uRedMoon > .001 && position.x > 1120. && position.x < 1690.
          && position.y > 87. && position.y < 555.) {
        vec2 moonPoint = (position - vec2(1402.2, 388.8)) / vec2(221.8, 247.2);
        float distanceToMoon = sqrt(dot(moonPoint, moonPoint) + .0097 * moonPoint.x * moonPoint.y);
        float ridge = 507. - .44 * (position.x - 1200.);
        ridge += -0.0400000 * max(0., position.x - 1225.);
        ridge += -0.2400000 * max(0., position.x - 1250.);
        ridge += 0.1200000 * max(0., position.x - 1275.);
        ridge += 0.2400000 * max(0., position.x - 1300.);
        ridge += -0.2000000 * max(0., position.x - 1325.);
        ridge += 0.2400000 * max(0., position.x - 1350.);
        ridge += 0.1866667 * max(0., position.x - 1375.);
        ridge += 0.2666667 * max(0., position.x - 1390.);
        ridge += -0.1333333 * max(0., position.x - 1405.);
        ridge += 0.6000000 * max(0., position.x - 1420.);
        ridge += -0.0800000 * max(0., position.x - 1450.);
        ridge += -0.0400000 * max(0., position.x - 1475.);
        ridge += -0.1200000 * max(0., position.x - 1500.);
        ridge += -0.0400000 * max(0., position.x - 1550.);
        ridge += -0.0800000 * max(0., position.x - 1575.);
        ridge += 0.0400000 * max(0., position.x - 1600.);
        float aboveFuji = 1. - smoothstep(ridge - 2.5, ridge + 1.5, position.y);
        float lunarDisc = (1. - smoothstep(.981, 1.017, distanceToMoon)) * aboveFuji;
        float sourceLight = dot(picture.rgb, vec3(.2126, .7152, .0722));
        vec3 mutedRose = vec3(.84, .48, .61) * (.62 + .38 * sourceLight);
        picture.rgb = mix(picture.rgb, mutedRose, lunarDisc * uRedMoon * .75);

        float halo = (1. - smoothstep(1.0, 1.16, distanceToMoon))
          * smoothstep(.985, 1.025, distanceToMoon);
        float mist = .65 + .22 * sin(moonPoint.y * 8.4 + moonPoint.x * 3.9 - uWaterTime * .37)
          + .13 * sin(moonPoint.y * 15.1 - moonPoint.x * 2.3 + uWaterTime * .23);
        picture.rgb += vec3(.10, .025, .066) * halo * mist * aboveFuji * uRedMoon;
        float haze = smoothstep(.42, .93, mist) * lunarDisc * uRedMoon;
        picture.rgb = mix(picture.rgb, vec3(.73, .52, .66), .21 * haze);

        // Nearby clouds and the upper ridge catch a little of the same rose light.
        float nearLimb = smoothstep(.98, 1.04, distanceToMoon)
          * (1. - smoothstep(1.045, 1.19, distanceToMoon));
        float ridgeLight = (1. - aboveFuji)
          * (1. - smoothstep(4., 48., position.y - ridge))
          * (1. - smoothstep(.87, 1.075, distanceToMoon));
        float spill = max(nearLimb * aboveFuji * .72, ridgeLight)
          * (1. - smoothstep(522., 553., position.y));
        float litDetail = mix(.32, 1., smoothstep(.045, .42, sourceLight));
        picture.rgb += vec3(.12, .031, .047) * spill * litDetail * uRedMoon;
      }
      if (uRedMoon > .001) {
        // Soft red spill on the distant gate, strongest around its crossbar and feet.
        if (position.x > 1320. && position.x < 1610. && position.y > 602. && position.y < 820.) {
          float crossbar = (1. - smoothstep(65., 144., abs(position.x - 1466.)))
            * (1. - smoothstep(9., 56., abs(position.y - 658.)));
          float pillar = (1. - smoothstep(3., 28., min(abs(position.x - 1417.), abs(position.x - 1510.))))
            * smoothstep(647., 684., position.y) * (1. - smoothstep(760., 811., position.y));
          float ember = .86 + .14 * sin(uWaterTime * 1.68);
          picture.rgb += vec3(.27, .086, .064) * max(crossbar * .73, pillar) * ember * uRedMoon;
        }
        if (position.x > 2040. && position.x < 2160. && position.y > 274. && position.y < 448.) {
          // Reuse the existing lit window pixels, each tier with a different fire rhythm.
          float floorMask = max(
            1. - smoothstep(7., 19., abs(position.y - 297.)),
            max(1. - smoothstep(8., 19., abs(position.y - 358.)),
                1. - smoothstep(10., 22., abs(position.y - 426.))));
          float windowPixel = smoothstep(.06, .36, picture.r - picture.b)
            * smoothstep(.18, .52, picture.r);
          float time = uWaterTime;
          float fire = .64 + .24 * sin(time * 7.8 + position.x * .17 + position.y * .08)
            + .12 * sin(time * 12.3 - position.x * .11 + position.y * .1);
          picture.rgb += vec3(.55, .28, .072) * floorMask * windowPixel * fire * uRedMoon;
        }
      }
      gl_FragColor = picture;
    }`;

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.className = 'blade-living-sakura';
  canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', {alpha: false, antialias: false});
  if (!gl) return;

  function compile(type, code) {
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(shader, code);
    gl.compileShader(shader);
    return gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS) ? shader : null;
  }

  const vertex = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, `
    attribute vec2 aPosition;
    varying vec2 vView;
    void main() {
      vView = vec2(aPosition.x * .5 + .5, .5 - aPosition.y * .5);
      gl_Position = vec4(aPosition, 0., 1.);
    }`);
  const pixels = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragment);
  if (!vertex || !pixels) return;
  const program = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
  gl.attachShader(program, pixels);
  gl.linkProgram(program);
  if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) return;
  gl.useProgram(program);

  const buffer = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const vertexPosition = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'aPosition');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(vertexPosition);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(vertexPosition, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  gl.uniform4fv(gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uRegions[0]'), new Float32Array(regions.flatMap(r => r.slice(0, 4))));
  const cover = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uCover');
  const waterTime = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uWaterTime');
  const redMoon = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uRedMoon');
  const windUniform = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uWind');
  let petalAnimations = [];
  let lastWindRate = 1;
  const bladeCenter = document.getElementById('bladeCenter');
  const tipRippleAge = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uTipRippleAge');
  const tipRippleOrigin = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uTipRippleOrigin');
  let rippleStartedAt = null;
  const shift = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uOffsets[0]');
  const offsets = new Float32Array(regions.length * 2);

  function separatePetal(image, region) {
    const [x, y, rx, ry, brightPetal] = region;
    const left = Math.max(0, x - rx);
    const top = Math.max(0, y - ry);
    const width = Math.min(image.canvas.width - left, rx * 2 + 1);
    const height = Math.min(image.canvas.height - top, ry * 2 + 1);
    const area = width * height;
    const original = image.getImageData(left, top, width, height);
    const data = original.data;
    const coverage = new Float32Array(area);
    for (let i = 0; i < area; i++) {
      const dx = (left + i % width - x) / rx;
      const dy = (top + Math.floor(i / width) - y) / ry;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > .87) continue;
      const [r, g, b] = [data[i * 4], data[i * 4 + 1], data[i * 4 + 2]];
      // The near-white petal under the title loses its pink contrast in the bright center.
      const strength = brightPetal
        ? (r - 94) / 76
        : Math.min((r - g - 12) / 32, (r - b + 30) / 32, (r - 97) / 59);
      coverage[i] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, strength));
    }

    const seed = (y - top) * width + x - left;
    if (coverage[seed] < .12) return null;
    const component = new Uint8Array(area);
    const queue = [seed];
    component[seed] = 1;
    function add(i) {
      if (component[i] || coverage[i] < .10) return;
      component[i] = 1;
      queue.push(i);
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < queue.length; j++) {
      const i = queue[j];
      if (i % width > 0) add(i - 1);
      if (i % width + 1 < width) add(i + 1);
      if (i >= width) add(i - width);
      if (i + width < area) add(i + width);
    }
    if (queue.length < 12) return null;

    const sprite = document.createElement('canvas');
    sprite.width = width;
    sprite.height = height;
    const pixels = sprite.getContext('2d');
    const isolated = pixels.createImageData(width, height);
    const cut = new Uint8Array(area);
    for (const i of queue) {
      const offset = i * 4;
      isolated.data.set(data.subarray(offset, offset + 3), offset);
      isolated.data[offset + 3] = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, coverage[i] * 1.5));
      const py = Math.floor(i / width);
      const px = i % width;
      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
        for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
          if (px + dx >= 0 && px + dx < width && py + dy >= 0 && py + dy < height) {
            cut[i + dy * width + dx] = 1;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    pixels.putImageData(isolated, 0, 0);

    const clean = image.createImageData(width, height);
    clean.data.set(data);
    for (let row = 0; row < height; row++) {
      for (let col = 0; col < width; col++) {
        const i = row * width + col;
        if (!cut[i]) continue;
        let l = col, r = col, u = row, d = row;
        while (l > 0 && cut[row * width + l]) l--;
        while (r + 1 < width && cut[row * width + r]) r++;
        while (u > 0 && cut[u * width + col]) u--;
        while (d + 1 < height && cut[d * width + col]) d++;
        const sources = [row * width + l, row * width + r, u * width + col, d * width + col];
        const weights = [col - l, r - col, row - u, d - row].map((distance, index) =>
          cut[sources[index]] ? 0 : 1 / Math.max(1, distance) ** 1.6);
        const total = weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
        if (!total) continue;
        for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
          clean.data[i * 4 + c] = sources.reduce((sum, source, index) =>
            sum + weights[index] * data[source * 4 + c], 0) / total;
        }
      }
    }
    image.putImageData(clean, left, top);
    return sprite;
  }

  function driftPetals(image) {
    const layer = document.querySelector('.blade-sakura');
    if (!layer) return;
    const paint = document.createElement('canvas');
    paint.width = image.naturalWidth;
    paint.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = paint.getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently: true});
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    for (const [i, position] of loosePetals.entries()) {
      const sprite = separatePetal(context, position);
      if (!sprite) continue;
      const mover = document.createElement('span');
      mover.className = 'blade-painted-petal';
      mover.style.setProperty('--start-height', (4 + i * 17 % 52) + 'vh');
      mover.style.setProperty('--drop', 'min(' + (34 + i * 9 % 17) + 'vw, 41vh)');
      mover.style.setProperty('--duration', (10 + i * 3 % 7) + 's');
      mover.style.setProperty('--delay', (-(i * 2.71 + 4) % 12) + 's');
      mover.style.setProperty('--tumble', (2.1 + i % 6 * .34) + 's');
      mover.style.setProperty('--opacity', String(.72 + i % 4 * .08));
      sprite.style.setProperty('--petal-span', 'max(' + (sprite.width / 25.6).toFixed(3) + 'vw, ' + (sprite.width / 14.4).toFixed(3) + 'vh)');
      mover.append(sprite);
      layer.append(mover);
    }
    return paint;
  }

  const image = new Image();
  let frame = 0;
  let last = -Infinity;
  function draw(now) {
    frame = 0;
    if (reduceMotion.matches || document.hidden || gl.isContextLost()) return;
    if (now - last >= 40) {
      last = now;
      const w = canvas.clientWidth;
      const h = canvas.clientHeight;
      if (w && h) {
        const ratio = Math.min(1, 1200 / w, 850 / h);
        const width = Math.round(w * ratio);
        const height = Math.round(h * ratio);
        if (canvas.width !== width || canvas.height !== height) {
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          gl.viewport(0, 0, width, height);
        }
        const scale = Math.max(w / image.width, h / image.height);
        gl.uniform2f(cover, w / (scale * image.width), h / (scale * image.height));
        const seconds = now / 1000;
        // One gust envelope bends the vegetation, carries petals and lifts the water.
        const voiceLight = Number(getComputedStyle(bladeCenter).getPropertyValue('--katana-voice-light'));
        const gust = voiceLight * (.77 + .23 * Math.sin(seconds * 1.45));
        const windRate = 1 + .83 * gust;
        if (Math.abs(windRate - lastWindRate) >= .025 || (gust === 0 && lastWindRate !== 1)) {
          for (const animation of petalAnimations) animation.updatePlaybackRate(windRate);
          lastWindRate = windRate;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < regions.length; i++) {
          const phase = seconds * (.78 + i % 5 * .15) + i * 1.71;
          const onBank = i >= branches.length;
          const lean = gust * (onBank ? 8.5 : 8);
          offsets[i * 2] = Math.sin(phase) * regions[i][4] * (1 + gust * .32) + lean;
          offsets[i * 2 + 1] = Math.sin(phase + .8) * regions[i][5] * (1 + gust * .22);
        }
        gl.uniform2fv(shift, offsets);
        gl.uniform1f(waterTime, seconds);
        gl.uniform1f(windUniform, gust);
        gl.uniform1f(redMoon, voiceLight);
        if (bladeCenter.dataset.speaking === 'true') rippleStartedAt ??= now;
        else if (voiceLight < .001) rippleStartedAt = null;
        if (rippleStartedAt === null) {
          gl.uniform1f(tipRippleAge, -1);
        } else {
          const blade = bladeCenter.getBoundingClientRect();
          const tipX = blade.left - blade.height * .019;
          const tipY = blade.top + blade.height * .9865;
          const imageLeft = (w - image.width * scale) / 2;
          gl.uniform2f(tipRippleOrigin, (tipX - imageLeft) / scale,
            Math.min(1150, Math.max(851, tipY / scale)));
          gl.uniform1f(tipRippleAge, (now - rippleStartedAt) / 1000);
        }
        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
      }
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  function update() {
    if (!frame && !reduceMotion.matches && !document.hidden) frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  image.addEventListener('load', () => {
    const texture = gl.createTexture();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, driftPetals(image) || image);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    document.getElementById('bladeTheme').prepend(canvas);
    function refreshPetalAnimations() {
      petalAnimations = document.querySelector('.blade-sakura')?.getAnimations({subtree: true})
        .filter(animation => ['blade-petal-fall', 'blade-petal-tumble', 'blade-painted-tumble'].includes(animation.animationName)) || [];
      lastWindRate = 1;
      update();
    }
    refreshPetalAnimations();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', update);
    reduceMotion.addEventListener('change', refreshPetalAnimations);
    canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => {
      for (const animation of petalAnimations) animation.updatePlaybackRate(1);
      canvas.remove();
    });
    update();
  }, {once: true});
  image.src = source;
})();
</script>

<style id="katana-fringe-motion">
#bladeCenter .muramasa-tassel-rendered { visibility: hidden; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #bladeCenter .muramasa-tassel-fringe { display: none; }
  #bladeCenter .muramasa-tassel-rendered { visibility: visible; }
}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const center = document.getElementById('bladeCenter');
  const tassel = center.querySelector('img.muramasa-tassel');
  if (!tassel) return;

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.className = 'muramasa-tassel muramasa-tassel-fringe';
  canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  canvas.style.cssText = tassel.style.cssText;
  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', { alpha: true, antialias: false });
  if (!gl) return;

  function makeShader(type, code) {
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(shader, code);
    gl.compileShader(shader);
    return gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS) ? shader : null;
  }

  const vertex = makeShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, `
    attribute vec2 aPosition;
    varying vec2 vPoint;
    void main() {
      vPoint = vec2(aPosition.x * .5 + .5, .5 - aPosition.y * .5);
      gl_Position = vec4(aPosition, 0., 1.);
    }`);
  const fragment = makeShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, `
    precision mediump float;
    uniform sampler2D uTassel;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uGust;
    varying vec2 vPoint;

    void main() {
      // Keep the cord and knot together. Neighboring bunches of silk
      // lag the wind by different amounts, with the most give at the ends.
      float fringe = smoothstep(.49, .93, vPoint.y);
      float edge = smoothstep(0., .06, vPoint.x)
        * (1. - smoothstep(.94, 1., vPoint.x));
      float phase = vPoint.x * 21. + vPoint.y * 3.1;
      float push = sin(uTime * 2.4 + phase) * .010
        + sin(uTime * 1.65 - phase * .77) * .005;
      push += uGust * (.101 + .028 * sin(uTime * 4.45 + phase));
      float lift = sin(uTime * 2.1 + phase * .83) * .0045
        - uGust * (.024 + .009 * sin(uTime * 3.65 + phase * .83));
      gl_FragColor = texture2D(uTassel, vPoint - vec2(push, lift) * fringe * edge);
    }`);
  if (!vertex || !fragment) return;
  const program = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
  gl.attachShader(program, fragment);
  gl.linkProgram(program);
  if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) return;

  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let frame = 0;
  let last = -Infinity;
  let ready = false;
  const time = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uTime');
  const gust = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uGust');
  function draw(now) {
    frame = 0;
    if (reduce.matches || document.hidden || window.__nxBootHold || gl.isContextLost()) return;
    if (now - last >= 40) {
      last = now;
      const seconds = now / 1000;
      const voiceLight = Number(getComputedStyle(center).getPropertyValue('--katana-voice-light'));
      // Match the wind pulse that speeds up the falling petals.
      gl.uniform1f(gust, voiceLight * (.77 + .23 * Math.sin(seconds * 1.45)));
      gl.uniform1f(time, seconds);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function update() {
    if (ready && !frame && !reduce.matches && !document.hidden && !window.__nxBootHold) {
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
  }

  function mount() {
    if (!tassel.naturalWidth || gl.isContextLost()) return;
    canvas.height = 360;
    canvas.width = Math.round(canvas.height * tassel.naturalWidth / tassel.naturalHeight);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    gl.useProgram(program);
    const buffer = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1, 1,-1, -1,1, 1,1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    const position = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'aPosition');
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(position);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(position, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    const texture = gl.createTexture();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, texture);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, true);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, tassel);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.uniform1f(time, 0);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    tassel.after(canvas);
    tassel.classList.add('muramasa-tassel-rendered');
    ready = true;
    update();
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => {
    ready = false;
    canvas.remove();
    tassel.classList.remove('muramasa-tassel-rendered');
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', update);
  reduce.addEventListener('change', update);
  window.addEventListener('nx-boot-ready', update, { once: true });
  if (tassel.complete) mount();
  else tassel.addEventListener('load', mount, { once: true });
})();
</script>

<style id="katana-speaking-tip-light">
#bladeCenter .katana-blade-threads {
  position: absolute;
  top: 27%;
  left: -49px;
  width: 98px;
  height: 72%;
  opacity: var(--katana-voice-light);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  #bladeCenter .katana-blade-threads { left: -35px; width: 70px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #bladeCenter .katana-blade-threads { display: none; }
}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const center = document.getElementById('bladeCenter');
  if (!center) return;
  const threads = document.createElement('canvas');
  threads.className = 'katana-blade-threads';
  threads.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  threads.width = 128;
  threads.height = 600;
  center.append(threads);
  const ctx = threads.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return;
  const {width, height} = threads;
  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  const strands = [
    {side: -1, phase: 1.35, color: '126,173,245', highlight: '186,220,255', width: 3.6, intensity: .32, speed: 1.17},
    {side: 1, phase: 3.6, color: '116,163,239', highlight: '174,213,255', width: 3.15, intensity: .27, speed: 1.26},
    {side: -1, phase: .3, color: '239,93,166', highlight: '255,192,217', width: 1.8},
    {side: 1, phase: 2.1, color: '201,110,246', highlight: '242,181,250', width: 1.5},
    {side: 1, phase: 4.7, color: '245,87,112', highlight: '255,222,174', width: 1.15}
  ];
  let frame = 0;
  let last = -Infinity;

  function draw(now) {
    frame = 0;
    if (reduce.matches || document.hidden || window.__nxBootHold) return;
    const speaking = center.dataset.speaking === 'true';
    const strength = Number(getComputedStyle(center).getPropertyValue('--katana-voice-light'));
    if (!speaking && strength < .003) {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      return;
    }
    if (now - last >= 32) {
      last = now;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      for (const strand of strands) {
        const {side, phase, color, highlight, intensity = 1, speed = 1} = strand;
        const t = now / 1000 * speed;
        const breath = intensity * (.77 + .22 * Math.sin(t * 3.15 + phase));
        const glow = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
        glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${color},0)`);
        glow.addColorStop(.13, `rgba(${color},${.56 * breath})`);
        glow.addColorStop(.42 + .23 * Math.sin(t * 2.1 + phase), `rgba(${highlight},${breath})`);
        glow.addColorStop(.81, `rgba(${color},${.91 * breath})`);
        glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${color},0)`);
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += 6) {
          const p = y / height;
          const x = width / 2 - 12 * p ** 4 + side * (9 + 5 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI))
            + Math.sin(p * 12.1 + t * 4 + phase) * (8.5 + 10.5 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI))
            + Math.sin(p * 21 + t * 5.3 - phase) * 3.4;
          if (y === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.strokeStyle = glow;
        ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${color},${.78 * intensity})`;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 11;
        ctx.lineWidth = strand.width;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function update() {
    if (!frame && !reduce.matches && !document.hidden && !window.__nxBootHold
        && center.dataset.speaking === 'true') frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  new MutationObserver(update).observe(center, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-speaking']});
  window.addEventListener('nx-boot-ready', update, {once: true});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', update);
  reduce.addEventListener('change', update);
  update();
})();
</script>

<style id="katana-voice-light-fade">

  syntax: "<number>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0;
}
#bladeCenter {
  --katana-voice-light: 0;
  transition: --katana-voice-light 3s ease-in-out;

}

    drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgb(165 35 101 / calc(var(--katana-voice-light) * .52)));
  transition: none;
}

  body #typingStatus { min-width: 0 !important; box-sizing: border-box; }

<script>
(() => {
  const viewport = window.visualViewport;
  if (!viewport) return;
  const input = document.getElementById('typingStatus');
  const update = () => {
    const keyboard = document.activeElement === input && viewport.scale === 1
      ? Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - viewport.height - viewport.offsetTop) : 0;
    document.body.style.setProperty('--katana-keyboard', keyboard + 'px');
  };
  viewport.addEventListener('resize', update);
  viewport.addEventListener('scroll', update);
  input.addEventListener('blur', () => document.body.style.removeProperty('--katana-keyboard'));
})();
</script>
